note: Blackford County (IN) has no queryable zoning district service found. Zoning districts exist only as the 1988 Ordinance 88-5 (scanned PDF, maps kept at county offices), covering the county, Hartford City and Montpelier. The county's Beacon (Schneider) viewer may show a zoning layer but returned a Cloudflare block and is not a public REST service. No ArcGIS Online, Indiana state (gisdata.in.gov) or city zoning layer for Blackford was found.
